title: feat(spec): list views offer Hide Fields by default — userActions.hideFields defaults to true
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XsdB5Zc6oHVNgmxpWpMbSZ)_
Fixes #28912

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：列表视图的「隐藏字段」按钮改为默认显示；应用写 `userActions: { hideFields: false }` 才会关掉。spec 默认值、列表渲染器的读取、默认值变更台账三处同步。
- 为什么改：读者想去掉不需要的列却无处可点，CRM 示例和生成的应用都没打开这个开关。旧的默认关是照抄渲染器历史写法，不是产品选择；您已批准翻转。
- 风险与回滚：每个没声明该键的列表都会多一个按钮。隐藏只影响该读者自己（有 columns 的视图或保存视图存到其个人列表状态，系统视图仅本次会话），从不写共享视图。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`（hideFields 默认值与上方注释）、`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`（`showHideFields` 一行）、`packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts`（台账新行）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.test.tsx -t "Hide fields"`，预期全部通过，其中含「未声明时显示」「声明 false 时不显示」两条新用例。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: `UserActionsConfigSchema.hideFields` goes from `.default(false)` to `.default(true)`. The describe and the block comment above the schema now say why (maintainer ruling on #28912) and where the reader's choice is kept.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`: `showHideFields: ua?.hideFields !== false` (was `=== true`), and the comment above it changes with it.
- `packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts`: the protocol-18 row `ui/UserActionsConfig:hideFields`, `false` to `true`, with the reason a build prints.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/ui/{view,page}.mdx` (the default column and describe) and `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/ui.json` (one fingerprint line).
- `.changeset/28912-hide-fields-default-on.md`: `@objectstack/spec` and `@object-ui/plugin-list`, minor.
- Not touched, per the card: `persistHiddenFields` and the objectui#10694 session-only rule in `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`, and the record-details component's `hideFields` (a `string[]`).

## Tests

Forced edits (they pinned the old default):
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.test.ts` "should apply default values": `hideFields` now expects `true`.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.test.ts` the defaults-asymmetry pin: renamed to "pins the group-ON / hideFields-ON / rowColor-OFF defaults" and expects `true`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.test.tsx` "should keep the legacy show* flags working": a legacy `showHideFields: true` is now indistinguishable from silence, so the fold is pinned by `showHideFields: false` (control absent).

New:
- `view.test.ts` "hideFields defaults ON (maintainer ruling)": absent parses to `true` (schema and through `ListViewSchema`), explicit `false` stays `false`, no `userActions` block materialises none.
- `ListView.test.tsx`: the control is drawn when `userActions` omits `hideFields`, and not drawn for `hideFields: false`.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise check (run first, on `main` 135054eb with `ListView.tsx` at `main`'s `=== true` read): `ObjectView.emptyColumnsNoProjection-10694.test.tsx` and `ObjectView.userListState-12418.test.tsx`, 43/43 passed. They drive the real ListView Display popover and its Hide Fields checkbox: the column goes; on a view that declares `columns` and on a saved view the choice is stored on the user's own list state and re-applied after a remount, and the view is not written; on a system view with no `columns` it is session-only and nothing is stored; another user sees the defaults. So the control works end to end and the flip does not spread a broken control.
- Interface pages are unchanged on purpose: `InterfaceListPage.tsx` keeps its closed-by-default toolbar (`hideFields: userActions.hideFields === true`, like `filter`, `rowHeight`, `group`). A page `interfaceConfig.userActions` block that omits the key parses to `true`, but that page still draws the control only for an explicit `true`. The ledger reason and the changeset say so.
- `ui/packages/core/src/utils/normalize-list-view.ts` around line 400 still says "hideFields/rowColor default OFF" in a comment. It is outside this card's file surface, so it is left for the seat.
- No ADR-0087 D3 semantic migration entry is added: it is outside the claimed file surface. The three earlier UI default flips (`editInline`, `pageSize`, nav-group `expanded`) each carry one; see the report's open question.

## Verification
